title: One Reader over several files

notes.author: Jack Roddy/d58bf845
notes.text: `Aggregate<I>` is not involved: this is a `Reader` spanning sources, where `Aggregate` spans `Indexable`s. Sharing a name would suggest a relationship that is not there.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/d58bf845
notes.text: If this and the parts file shared one list of files, the counting pass would go away because the counts are stamped already.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/c45d6630
notes.text: Left the milestone sail-31fdd9. This is the one issue that needs both streaming (sail-317db4) and the index-file work. It waits on each separately rather than living inside either.
